title: Quantized Transport in Interacting Disordered Systems
exact_target: Build a theory of Hall plateaux and critical charge transport that includes both interactions and disorder.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003147 (OWR-14608-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Renormalization Group (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/26, pp. 1453--1515. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 45.
Mastropietro, Quantization of the interacting Hall conductivity (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
current primary work on interacting disordered edge transport (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This is a theory-development programme, not a universal quantization theorem for arbitrary interacting disordered Hamiltonians. The symmetry, dimensional, temperature and localization regimes are not fixed in the extracted question.
